feedback_by_option.fil: Tama. Wala kang water-rescue training, kaya manatili sa tuyong lupa at tawagin ang sanay na rescuer.
feedback_by_option.en: Correct. You have no water-rescue training, so you stay on dry ground and call trained rescuers.

feedback_by_option.fil: Mapanganib din sa iyo ang paglusong nang walang rescue training. Tawagin ang sanay na rescuer.
feedback_by_option.en: Entering unsafe water without rescue training puts you at risk too. Call trained rescuers instead.

feedback_by_option.fil: Naaantala ang rescue kung maghihintay. Tawagin na ngayon ang sanay na rescuer mula sa tuyong lupa.
feedback_by_option.en: Waiting delays rescue. Call trained rescuers now, from dry ground.

feedback_by_option.fil: Huwag baligtarin ang tao para patuluin ang tubig. Ayusin ang agarang pagsusuri at sundin ang kasalukuyang drowning protocol.
feedback_by_option.en: Do not invert the person to drain water. Arrange urgent medical assessment and follow the current drowning protocol.

feedback_by_option.fil: Tama. Kapag nailigtas, kailangan ng agarang medikal na pagsusuri ayon sa kasalukuyang drowning resuscitation protocol.
feedback_by_option.en: Correct. Once rescued, the person needs urgent medical assessment under the current drowning resuscitation protocol.

feedback_by_option.fil: Hindi pa tapos ang pangangailangan sa tulong dahil lang nakaahon na. Ayusin ang agarang medikal na pagsusuri.
feedback_by_option.en: Being out of the water does not end the need for care. Arrange urgent medical assessment.
